subject: english
title: 七下英语同步章节卷 · Units 3–4
label: Units 3–4 Keep Fit · Eat Well
unit: 七下·Units 3–4 Keep Fit / Eat Well
source: 人教版七年级下册 Unit 3 Keep Fit、Unit 4 Eat Well：运动与健康、can 表能力、how often 与频度副词、be good at doing、可数与不可数名词、some / any、how many / how much、健康饮食建议。按初一单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem:
—______ do you exercise?
—Three times a week.
items.exp: 回答的是频率（一周三次），用 how often 提问。

items.stem: Lily ______ eats junk food because she thinks it's bad for her health.
items.exp: 她认为垃圾食品对健康不好，所以从不吃：never。

items.stem: Tom is good at ______ basketball. He is in the school team.
items.exp: be good at 中的 at 是介词，后接动词 -ing 形式。

items.stem:
—Can you swim?
—______. I'm in the swimming club.
items.exp: Can 提问用 can 回答；参加了游泳俱乐部，肯定会游泳。

items.stem: There ______ some milk and two eggs on the table.
items.exp: 就近原则：离 be 最近的是不可数名词 milk，用 is。

items.stem:
—How ______ eggs do you eat every day?
—Two.
items.exp: eggs 是可数名词复数，问数量用 how many。how much 问不可数名词的量或价格。

items.stem: I'm thirsty. I'd like a glass of ______.
items.exp: a glass of 一杯，后接饮料。bread 不能论杯。

items.stem: Eating too much junk food is bad ______ our health.
items.exp: be bad for 对……有害；be good for 对……有益。

items.stem:
—Would you like some orange juice?
—______. I'm really thirsty.
items.exp: 接受别人提供的东西用 Yes, please。坑点：Would you like ...? 不用 Yes, I would 回答。

items.stem: Is there ______ bread in the fridge? I'm hungry.
items.exp: 一般疑问句中用 any；bread 不可数，不能用 a 或 many。坑点：表示请求、建议的问句（Would you like ...?）才用 some。

items.stem: Doing sports every day can help us ______ healthy.
items.exp: help sb. (to) do sth.，后接动词原形。

items.stem: It's important to have a ______ diet. Eat more vegetables and less meat.
items.exp: 多吃蔬菜少吃肉，是均衡的饮食 a balanced diet。

items.stem: My sister doesn't like vegetables, ______ she eats some every day for her health.
items.exp: 不喜欢，却每天吃一些，前后转折，用 but。

items.stem:
—I often feel tired these days.
—You should ______ more exercise and go to bed early.
items.exp: should 后接动词原形。

items.stem:
—Let's play ping-pong after school.
—______ I love it!
items.exp: 回应别人的提议并表示赞同，用 That's a good idea。

sections.title: Jim's New Plan
sections.passage:
Jim is a 13-year-old boy. He loves eating hamburgers and drinking cola, but he (16) eats vegetables. After school, he plays computer games for hours. He doesn't like sports at all, so he is not very (17). He often feels tired in class.
One day, his mother takes him to see a doctor. The doctor says, "You need to change your (18). Eat more fruit and vegetables, and drink more (19) instead of cola. Also, you should exercise at least three (20) a week."
Now Jim has a new plan. He has milk, an egg and some bread for (21) every morning. He eats junk food only once a week. After school, he (22) basketball with his friends for an hour. On weekends, he goes swimming with his dad. He is (23) at swimming now, and he can swim 500 metres!
Jim feels much better these days. He isn't tired in class any more, and his grades are getting (24). He says, "Healthy food and sports (25) me happy every day."

items.exp: but 表转折：爱吃汉堡、喝可乐，却从不吃蔬菜。
完全不运动，所以不太健康；后面说上课常觉得累。
医生让他改变的是生活习惯 habits，后面都是饮食、运动建议。
多喝水代替可乐：drink more water instead of cola。
一周至少锻炼三次：three times a week。
every morning，早餐 breakfast。
放学后和朋友打篮球一小时：play basketball。
能游 500 米，说明擅长游泳：be good at。
身体好了、上课不累了，成绩也越来越好。
make sb.＋形容词：使某人……。let 后接动词原形，不能接 happy。

items.stem: How much does a 10-year-old boy pay to go swimming?
items.exp: children under 12: ¥15，10 岁按儿童价。

items.stem: When can people take a yoga class?
items.exp: Tuesday and Thursday, 7:00–8:00 p.m.。

items.stem: Who can join the Kids' Basketball Club?

items.stem: Mr. and Mrs. Li play badminton on one court for two hours. How much do they pay?

groups.label: B
groups.title: Eat a Rainbow
groups.passage:
Do you know the saying "Eat a rainbow"? It means we should eat fruit and vegetables of different colours every day.
Red food, like tomatoes and strawberries, is good for our hearts. Orange and yellow food, like carrots and oranges, is good for our eyes. Green food, like broccoli and spinach, makes our bones strong. Blue and purple food, like grapes and eggplants, helps our memory.
Many children don't like vegetables. Here are some tips for parents. First, let children help in the kitchen. When they cook the vegetables themselves, they are happy to eat them. Second, make food look fun. For example, cut fruit into the shapes of animals. Third, don't give up. Some children need to try a new food ten times before they like it.
Remember, no single food has everything our bodies need. So eat a rainbow every day!

items.stem: What does "Eat a rainbow" mean?
options: Eat fruit and vegetables of different colours.
Eat a lot of sweet food.
items.exp: It means we should eat fruit and vegetables of different colours every day。

items.stem: Which food is good for our eyes?
items.exp: Orange and yellow food, like carrots and oranges, is good for our eyes。

items.stem: Which food helps our memory?
items.exp: Blue and purple food, like grapes and eggplants, helps our memory。

items.stem: How many tips does the writer give to parents?
items.exp: First、Second、Third，共三条。

items.stem: Why does the writer tell parents "don't give up"?
options: Because some children need to try a new food many times before they like it.
items.exp: Some children need to try a new food ten times before they like it。

sections.title: My Healthy Life
sections.passage:
Hello, I'm Anna. I think I have a healthy life. I eat three (36) (meal) a day. For breakfast, I usually have some bread, an egg and a glass of (37) m______. I eat lots of vegetables, but I don't eat (38) ______ junk food.
I also exercise every day. I'm good at (39) (run), and I'm in the school running club. I go swimming (40) (two) a week. I go to bed early (41) ______ I want to have enough sleep.
My father (42) (not like) sports. I often ask him to go for a walk with me after dinner. Now he (43) (walk) with me every evening. He says walking is (44) (real) relaxing. I think eating well and exercising can help us (45) (stay) healthy.

items.exp: three 后接可数名词复数 meals。
a glass of milk 一杯牛奶。
否定句中用 any；junk food 不可数，也可以说 not much。
be good at doing；run 要双写 n 再加 -ing。
两次用 twice，三次以上用“基数词＋times”。
早睡的原因是想睡够觉，用 because。
主语 My father 是第三人称单数，一般现在时否定用 doesn't＋动词原形。
every evening 表示经常性动作，主语 he，用 walks。
修饰形容词 relaxing 用副词 really。
help sb. (to) do sth.。

sections.prompt:
学校英语角正在开展“健康生活”主题活动。请以“My Healthy Habits”为题写一篇短文：1. 你的饮食习惯（早餐吃什么、喜欢哪些健康食物、怎样对待垃圾食品）；2. 你的运动习惯（做什么运动、多久一次）；3. 给同学们提一条健康建议。要求：60 词左右，题目已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
My Healthy Habits
points: 语言正确（频度副词、how often 类表达、可数与不可数名词），书写规范
sections.sample:
My Healthy Habits
I think I have healthy habits. I always eat breakfast. I usually have an egg, some bread and a glass of milk. I like fruit and vegetables very much, and I hardly ever eat junk food.
I exercise every day. I play basketball with my friends three times a week, and I go swimming on weekends.
Here is my advice: eat a balanced diet and exercise every day. Then you can keep fit and study well.
sections.exp: 写完检查：频度副词放在 be 动词之后、实义动词之前；milk、bread、food 不可数，不加 -s；“一周三次”是 three times a week。
